prompt: People now have the freedom to work and live anywhere in the world due to the development of communication technology and transportation. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own experience or knowledge.
essay:
The advancement of technology and transportation has led to freedom for people to choose a country they want to live in and work from anywhere. I believe this development brings stronger benefits than its potential drawbacks, as it can reduce stress and improve productivity.

On the one hand, working and living from anywhere has several disadvantages. Firstly, living abroad and far from our close relatives may make people feel lonely and isolated. For instance, when someone is moving to another country and works online, they tend to endure loneliness as they can not have direct social interaction with their coworkers. Secondly, it may bring a huge cost of living and housing too. Because remote workers may not be registered as  permanent residents, they may have to rent a house and pay monthlyrent whereas the cost probably expensive for shorttime period, especially in a large city.

On the other hand, freedom to choose a flexible way of life gives numerous advantages. First and foremost, it can significantly reduce stress due to the lack of need for office commuting. At this time, many businesses apply flexible working arrangements where employees can work from home. As a result, they are free from traffic and hot weather suffering. In addition, this life gives them more time  to sleep, have a good rest, and do sports. Furthermore, this trend also boost perfomance as workers have high privileges to design their own lives. For example, many people choose to work from a coffee shop in today's era because they have the freedom not to go to the office. They choose to work with their friends, order their favourite matcha latte, and have a good talk when break time comes.

In conclusion, I think flexible working and living arrangements bring more advantages than disadvantages. Although living and working abroad may lead to loneliness and expensive living costs, this development can reduce stress and increase performance at work.
